For example, `last_n([1, 2, 3, 4], 5)` returns `[4]` instead of all available items. Clamp the start index to zero. > >
> Suggested fix > > ```diff > - return items[len(items) - n:] > + return items[max(0, len(items) - n):] > ``` > >
